request_mechanism: urllib.request.urlopen(public official URL), without authentication handlers, cookies, account session, authorization headers or supplied credentials
interpretation: Anonymous server-issued download response session identifiers do not authorize an authenticated user/account; README no-credentials statement is accurate in that sense. Optional source-header sanitation is not required for mathematical or submission readiness. Exact fixed package remains unchanged.
scope: Concrete source/acquisition inspection, not an assumption that every session identifier is harmless.
